title: VanillaBoostP
description: This modpack is built to provide the best possible Minecraft performance while preserving a true vanilla experience.
body:
This modpack is built to provide the best possible Minecraft performance while preserving a true vanilla experience. Every included optimization has been carefully selected to improve FPS, reduce lag spikes, and enhance overall stability without altering core gameplay mechanics or changing the original feel of the game.

The goal of this pack is simple: make Minecraft run smoother and faster on all types of systems, from low-end PCs to high-performance setups. It optimizes rendering, memory usage, world loading, and general game performance, allowing players to enjoy longer play sessions with fewer slowdowns and improved responsiveness.

Unlike gameplay-focused modpacks, this pack does not introduce major progression changes or modify the balance of vanilla Minecraft. All core mechanics remain intact, ensuring full compatibility with existing worlds, servers, and most other mods. You get the same Minecraft experience you know — just faster, cleaner, and more stable.

In addition to performance improvements, the modpack also includes a selection of small and friendly quality-of-life additions. These mods provide useful and enjoyable enhancements that make the game more comfortable and pleasant to play, while still respecting the vanilla spirit and keeping gameplay familiar.

This modpack is ideal for players who want better performance without sacrificing the authentic Minecraft atmosphere. Whether you play survival, creative, multiplayer, or use additional mods, this pack aims to provide a reliable and optimized foundation for your game.
